The '''Lequana Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in [[Byllurun]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. It was located near the [[SoroSuub Centroplex]], and so was often used by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] employees. The center of the hotel contained a massive [[lava fountain]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
